name: mesa-inlist
description: Syntax highlighting, validation, hover docs and completion for MESA stellar evolution inlist files (inlist, project_inlist, pgstar, etc.). Built for MESA 26.4.

commands.title: MESA Inlist: Reload control database from MESA_DIR
MESA Inlist: Treat current file as a MESA inlist

mesaInlist.mesaDir.description: Path to a MESA source tree (e.g. ~/Documents/mesa/mesa_26_04_1). When set, the 'Reload control database' command re-parses this tree's defaults files at runtime. Leave empty to use the embedded database for MESA 26.4.

mesaInlist.reportUnknownControls.description: Mark control names that are not in the MESA defaults as errors (red). Disable if you use many custom controls via run_star_extras hooks.

mesaInlist.reportUnknownNamelists.description: Also warn about namelist sections that are not known to MESA (e.g. custom namelists).

mesaInlist.enableValueTypeChecking.description: Validate that each value has the correct type (logical, integer, real or string) for its control.

mesaInlist.enableEnumChecking.description: Warn when a string value is not one of the documented options for that control.
